subject: general
question:
A word in the following sentence is INCORRECTLY spelt. Select that word from the given options.

Fungal diseases in the lungs are often similar to other illnesses such as bacterial or viral pneumoniia
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**pneumoniia**" is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling should be "**pneumonia**."
 
• It is important to ensure correct spelling to maintain the accuracy and clarity of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Fungal diseases in the lungs are often similar to other illnesses such as bacterial or viral **pneumonia**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fungal diseases** – This part of the sentence is correct.
 
• **in the lungs are often similar to other illnesses** – This part of the sentence is correct.
 
• **such as bacterial or viral** – This part of the sentence is correct.
 
• **pneumonia** – The correct spelling of the word should be ensured.
